verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26428863 from Pune Diecast Works to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318745 (dated 2026-09-22). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-010, die-cast statue 'The Getaway' 18 cm, 2,600 pcs at 1037 INR, confirmed delivery 2026-12-07. Incoterms FOB Nhava Sheva, payment NET30. The supplier states it is approved for serial supply (PPAP submitted 2026-09-14).
red_flags: The 'approved for serial supply' status is the supplier's own statement on its acknowledgement, not an approval issued by the buyer.
The unit price has no unit of measure or per-quantity basis. The document has no issue date of its own; 2026-09-22 is the date of the buyer's order.
observations: Typed PDF, no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Confirmed date 2026-12-07 is a single date for the whole quantity; no partial deliveries listed.
